newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow on Tuesday, with steers and heifers steady to $1.00 per cwt lower than last week on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.

Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 112.00 to mostly 113.00 (weighted average 112.78). Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 112.00 to mostly 113.00, few 111.00 (weighted average 112.50).

Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were weak to $0.50 lower. Buyer inquiry and demand fairly good, seller interest limited. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 69.50-70.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 69.50-70.00.
Wk To Date - 9,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 36,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 15,600
